verdict.rationale: Live probes confirm Mastra serves an llms.txt at mastra.ai/llms.txt and a markdown docs endpoint (docs.md) whose preamble speaks directly to LLM readers, so an agent can be pointed at agent-oriented docs. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing the llms.txt/markdown docs offering and its coverage, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents successfully consuming it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
